Three lenses

We look at every business through three lenses.

Most businesses do not have an AI problem. They have a money problem that AI happens to be very good at solving. These are the three places we look first.

01

Leakage

Money the business is already earning but not keeping. Pricing drift, rework, unbilled work, leaked discounts, stock that quietly ages.

02

Concentration

Risk sitting in one customer, one supplier, one machine, or one person who holds the process in their head.

03

Gap

Work the business could be winning and is not — enquiries that go cold, capacity left idle, decisions taken too late to matter.

A short free call first, not a stageEvery engagement starts with a conversation to check fit.

Stage oneDiscovery: an owner interview, a sector study, a full diagnostic run on your own evidence.

You leave withA final report naming what to fix, what it is worth, and what to build first.

Stage twoImplementation: AI built into the workflows your team already uses, not a tool sitting beside them.

You leave withAI embedded in how the business runs day to day, and a measured result you can check yourself.
